The so-called "'''Halls of Enlightenment'''" was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] training facility built into the mountains near the [[Ruined City]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Manned by Sith and Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], it was used by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Beldiss]] to train failed [[Voss Mystics]].
